facts.statement: The genus Protocaiman was first described in 2018.
facts.quote: Protocaiman is a caimanine genus of crocodylian first described in 2018.

facts.statement: The type species Protocaiman peligrensis was discovered in the Salamanca Formation of Argentina.
facts.quote: The type species Protocaiman peligrensis was discovered in Argentina's Salamanca Formation

facts.statement: Protocaiman peligrensis lived in Patagonia during the Paleocene epoch.
facts.quote: and lived in Patagonia during the Paleocene epoch.

facts.statement: The holotype of Protocaiman peligrensis is the partial skull specimen MLP 80-X-10-1.
facts.quote: The holotype is specimen MLP 80-X-10-1, which is a partial skull.

facts.statement: Protocaiman is classified within the family Alligatoridae.
The genus Protocaiman existed from the Maastrichtian to the Danian, between 72.2 and 61.66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Danian (72.2 to 61.66 million years ago)
